Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne — passionate, hard-working, and ready to help with this. I have 7 years of experience building full stack web apps with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS.

For Pulsebox Studios, I built a white-label class booking app with subdomains, timetables, memberships, and Stripe billing. It onboarded 64 studios in 6 months and achieved a 71% checkout conversion.

For your project, I can help unify your Shopify stores, order tracking, customer tracking, and menu management across locations and channels. I understand the need to keep listings, menus, and ordering consistent across websites, social platforms, and delivery partners.

I’d be glad to discuss the best way to organize the platform and integrations so everything stays current and manageable.
